title: Automatic removal of ended delegation worktrees, once a runtime's stop can be proven
outcome: The sweep that w-e91a lands, which inspects each ended delegation's worktree and records a verdict, also removes a worktree with git worktree remove when its verdict is "nothing to lose found" and its child's runtime is provably stopped. Anything else keeps the worktree with its reason.
acceptance: Automatic removal of ended delegation worktrees, once a runtime's stop can be proven is done
